reuse.why: Fintegra shares linking and download helpers with existing providers, reuses findOrCreateBank, and shares local unlinking with the existing unlink action.

duplication.why: Most repeated logic is extracted, although GoCardless and linkProviderAccount retain parallel validation, bank lookup, release, save, sync, and completion orchestration.

placement.why: Link orchestration, transaction transport, server configuration, and provider models remain in their established layers.

scope.why: The refactoring supports the requested linking rules and provider addition, with only necessary client provider-map updates.

maintainability.why: Shared policy and unlink definitions simplify maintenance, though the assertion helper also resolves takeover candidates and the save helper weakens types to string and Record.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All linking paths use the shared validation and persistence helpers, and takeover and ordinary unlinking share releaseAccountLinks.

disguised_duplication.where: The extractions consolidate existing copies; the remaining parallel linking orchestration is explicit.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and centralizes the replacement-dependent refusal and closed-account refusal; these are required policy variations, and every provider uses them.
